title: Teachers trained in ICT and agriculture skills

subtasks.task_text: Describe the training program and its objectives.
subtasks.text: The training took place over two days at Isienodem Local Government Area in Aquabomb State, focusing on ICT and modern agriculture.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the training program and its objectives.
subtasks.text: The program aimed to empower teachers to integrate technology into agricultural practices to enhance teaching methods and productivity.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the training program and its objectives.
subtasks.text: Participants engaged in interactive sessions on digital farming techniques, mobile app usage for farm management, and online marketing strategies.

subtasks.task_text: Highlight participants' experiences and reactions to the training.
subtasks.text: Teachers at the training expressed enthusiasm about learning new skills, including practical farming and trading techniques.

subtasks.task_text: Highlight participants' experiences and reactions to the training.
subtasks.text: Participants noted that the training emphasized both theoretical and practical aspects, adapting to changes in teaching requirements.

subtasks.task_text: Highlight participants' experiences and reactions to the training.
subtasks.text: Some attendees felt the training empowered them with innovative tools and techniques for marketing agricultural products.

subtasks.task_text: Highlight participants' experiences and reactions to the training.
subtasks.text: The program also aimed to equip teachers with knowledge to share with peers and implement innovative practices in schools and communities.
